classification.difficultyReason: Combines two four-year depreciation periods with different rates and converts the combined multiplier to a total percentage decrease.

content.prompt: A special depreciation ruling was obtained from the Taxation Office on a particular piece of scientific apparatus. For the first four years, it depreciates at $32\%$ p.a., and, for the second four years, it depreciates at $22\%$ p.a. Find the total percentage decrease in value, correct to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked:
The annual remaining-value multipliers are $1-0.32=0.68$ and $1-0.22=0.78$.

Let the original value be $P$.

$$\begin{align*}A_8&=P(0.68)^4(0.78)^4\\\text{Percentage decrease}&=\left(1-\frac{P(0.68)^4(0.78)^4}{P}\right)\times100\%\\\text{Percentage decrease}&=\left(1-(0.68)^4(0.78)^4\right)\times100\%\\\text{Percentage decrease}&\approx92.09\%\end{align*}$$
